summary: AFK idle RPG! Collect heroes and build the ultimate team.
description:
Step into the paws of a guild leader in Castle Cats, the ultimate cat-themed adventure! Collect, evolve, and lead heroic cats on epic quests. Whether you play idly or dive into real-time battles, there’s always something cat-tastic happening in this free-to-play game.

FEATURES:
1. Idle & Action Gameplay
Let your cat heroes battle while you’re away. Return to collect rewards, upgrade your team, and summon new epic cats. Want more action? Jump in and help your cats in battle whenever you like!

2. Collect & Strategize
With over 400+ unique cat heroes, there’s always a new cat to discover! Summon, evolve, and unlock special traits, skills, and outfits. Meet famous cats like Cole and Marmalade, Hosico, Monty, Nala, Waffles, and more. Your cat guild awaits!

3. Customize Your Guild Leader
Express yourself with 200+ items to create a unique leader that’s as stylish as your cats.

4. Event-Packed Gameplay
Never a dull moment with regular cat-themed events like Superhero, Holiday, Summer, and Winter updates.

5. Captivating Story
Join your guild of cat heroes to defeat the EVIL PUGOMANCER. Experience a tale full of hilarious, cat-tastic puns and adventures. Every event adds 15 story-driven quests to expand the cat lore.

What are you waiting for? Download now and join the world of Castle Cats!
